title: Practice 1: Numerals, nouns and adjectives together

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Tom was a prisoner of war for three years.
exercises.why: **три года** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (год → года); 1, 21, 31… take the nominative singular.

exercises.prompt: I owe Tom thirty bucks.
exercises.why: **тридцать баксов** — round tens and hundreds (30, 50, 100, 800…) take the genitive plural (бакс → баксов).

exercises.prompt: How old are you both?
The smell took three days to wear off.
exercises.why: **три дня** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (день → дня); 1, 21, 31… take the nominative singular.

exercises.prompt: The two boys raced each other home.
exercises.why: **мальчик → мальчика** (gen. sg.: after оба). Declines like студент (G. sg. студента). Ending — (no ending) → -а.

exercises.prompt: The ammonia molecule is composed of four atoms.
exercises.why: **четыре → четырёх** (gen.: из + genitive). Numerals decline like adjectives in the plural; every part of a compound numeral declines.

exercises.prompt: I have three daughters to marry off.
exercises.why: **три дочери** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (дочь → дочери); 1, 21, 31… take the nominative singular.

exercises.prompt: We have little chance of winning.
exercises.why: **шанс → шансов** (gen. pl.: after мало). Declines like стол (G. pl. столов). Ending — (no ending) → -ов.

exercises.q: Торговый дисбаланс между ___ (два) странами следует выправить.
exercises.prompt: The trade imbalance between two nations should be improved.
exercises.why: **два → двумя** (instr.: между + instrumental). Numerals decline like adjectives in the plural; every part of a compound numeral declines.

exercises.q: Семь в четвёртой равно две ___ (тысяча) четыреста один.
exercises.prompt: Seven to the fourth power equals two thousand four hundred one.
exercises.why: **две тысячи** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (тысяча → тысячи); 1, 21, 31… take the nominative singular.

exercises.prompt: The cut will heal up in a few days.
exercises.why: **несколько дней** — несколько with something you can count takes the genitive plural (день → дней).

exercises.prompt: More than four million Syrians are refugees.

exercises.q: Том отнёс две ___ (коробка) в кладовую комнату.
exercises.prompt: Tom carried two boxes into the storage room.
exercises.why: **две коробки** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (коробка → коробки); 1, 21, 31… take the nominative singular.

exercises.q: Во всём мире почти девятьсот ___ (миллионы) человек недоедают.
exercises.prompt: Internationally, almost 900 million people don't have enough to eat.
exercises.why: **девятьсот миллионов** — round tens and hundreds (30, 50, 100, 800…) take the genitive plural (миллион → миллионов).

exercises.prompt: Two sheep were killed by a wolf.

exercises.q: Страна два ___ (десятилетие) жила под гнётом тирании.
exercises.prompt: The country bore the yoke of tyranny for two decades.
exercises.why: **два десятилетия** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (десятилетие → десятилетия); 1, 21, 31… take the nominative singular.

exercises.prompt: I only have two candles.
exercises.why: **две свечки** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (свечка → свечки); 1, 21, 31… take the nominative singular.

exercises.q: В Соединённых Штатах столовая ложка эквивалентна ___ (три) чайным.
exercises.prompt: In the United States, a tablespoon is equivalent to three teaspoons.
We've survived two wars.
exercises.why: **две войны** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (война → войны); 1, 21, 31… take the nominative singular.

exercises.prompt: Ziri heard a few branches snapping.
exercises.why: **несколько ветвей** — несколько with something you can count takes the genitive plural (ветвь → ветвей).
